command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_HTML=18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e
test "$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_HTML"
OUT=/var/tmp/go-avatar-eye-mask-shadow-v1
rm -rf "$OUT"; mkdir -p "$OUT/blink"
python3 - "$OUT" <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageFilter
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np, glob, hashlib, json, sys
out=Path(sys.argv[1])
def arr(p): return np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert('RGBA'))
openim=arr('augen_blink/blink_000.png'); closed=arr('augen_blink/blink_006.png')
d=np.max(np.abs(openim[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16)-closed[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16)),axis=2)
glow=arr('augen_gaze/rotglow_tracking_master.png')[:,:,3]>0
gy,gx=np.where(glow); fx0=max(0,int(gx.min())-35); fy0=max(0,int(gy.min())-35); fx1=min(d.shape[1],int(gx.max())+1+35); fy1=min(d.shape[0],int(gy.max())+1+35)
raw=(d>=70); focus=np.zeros_like(raw,bool); focus[fy0:fy1,fx0:fx1]=1; raw &= focus
closedmask=np.asarray(Image.fromarray((raw*255).astype('uint8')).filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(5)).filter(ImageFilter.MinFilter(5)))>0
# connected components, keep exactly two largest eye components
h,w=closedmask.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(closedmask,bool); comps=[]
for y in range(h):
 for x in range(w):
  if not closedmask[y,x] or seen[y,x]: continue
  q=[(y,x)]; seen[y,x]=1; pts=[]
  while q:
   yy,xx=q.pop(); pts.append((yy,xx))
   for dy in (-1,0,1):
    for dx in (-1,0,1):
     if not(dx or dy): continue
     ny,nx=yy+dy,xx+dx
     if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and closedmask[ny,nx] and not seen[ny,nx]: seen[ny,nx]=1; q.append((ny,nx))
  comps.append(pts)
comps=sorted(comps,key=len,reverse=True); assert len(comps)>=2
base=np.zeros_like(closedmask,bool)
for pts in comps[:2]:
 for y,x in pts: base[y,x]=1
# Include actual measured gaze signal pixels, then 6px hard margin plus 4px feather outside.
base |= glow
hard=np.asarray(Image.fromarray((base*255).astype('uint8')).filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(13)))
blur=np.asarray(Image.fromarray(hard).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(4.0)))
mask=np.maximum(hard,blur).astype(np.uint8)
Image.fromarray(mask,'L').save(out/'eye_identity_mask.png')
# Apply only mask alpha; RGB remains canonical photographed eye/skin texture.
assets=[]
for p in sorted(glob.glob('augen_blink/blink_*.png')):
 im=arr(p).copy(); im[:,:,3]=(im[:,:,3].astype(np.uint16)*mask.astype(np.uint16)//255).astype(np.uint8)
 dst=out/'blink'/Path(p).name; Image.fromarray(im,'RGBA').save(dst)
 assets.append((dst.name,hashlib.sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
# Open identity plate is frame 000 under same eye-only mask.
(out/'eye_identity_open.png').write_bytes((out/'blink'/'blink_000.png').read_bytes())
# Geometry and full-canvas impact on all 308 special-expression frames.
ys,xs=np.where(mask>0); bbox=(int(xs.min()),int(ys.min()),int(xs.max())+1,int(ys.max())+1)
core=mask>=240; mid=mask>=128; nz=mask>0
expr=sorted(glob.glob('ausdruck_erweitert/*/*/frontal/stufe_*.png')); assert len(expr)==308
W,H=Image.open(expr[0]).size; x0=round(W*.31); y0=round(H*.12); pw=round(W*.27); ph=round(pw*openim.shape[0]/openim.shape[1])
rmask=np.asarray(Image.fromarray(mask).resize((pw,ph),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)); rnz=rmask>0; rmid=rmask>=128; rcore=rmask>=240
basepatch=np.asarray(Image.open(out/'eye_identity_open.png').convert('RGBA').resize((pw,ph),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS))
# Enforce resized mask deterministically after resample.
basepatch=basepatch.copy(); basepatch[:,:,3]=(basepatch[:,:,3].astype(np.uint16)*rmask.astype(np.uint16)//255).astype(np.uint8)
change=[]; edge_delta=[]; core_delta=[]; outside_exact=[]
edge=(rmask>8)&(rmask<247)
for p in expr:
 e=np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert('RGBA')); roi=e[y0:y0+ph,x0:x0+pw,:3].astype(np.int16); bp=basepatch[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16)
 delta=np.mean(np.abs(bp-roi),axis=2)
 change.append(float((basepatch[:,:,3]>0).sum())/(W*H))
 if edge.any(): edge_delta.append(float(delta[edge].mean()))
 if rcore.any(): core_delta.append(float(delta[rcore].mean()))
 outside_exact.append(1.0) # compositing touches no pixel outside mapped mask rectangle by construction
manifest={
 'schema':'GO_AVATAR_EYE_IDENTITY_SHADOW/v1','source_html_sha256':'18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e',
 'derivation':'open-vs-closed max RGB delta >=70 within glow+35 focus; close5; two largest components; union glow; hard dilate6; feather4',
 'patch_bbox':bbox,'mask_pixels_nonzero':int(nz.sum()),'mask_pixels_a128':int(mid.sum()),'mask_pixels_a240':int(core.sum()),'patch_pixels':int(mask.size),
 'mapped_canvas':{'W':W,'H':H,'x':x0,'y':y0,'w':pw,'h':ph,'mask_nonzero_pixels':int(rnz.sum()),'mask_a128_pixels':int(rmid.sum()),'mask_a240_pixels':int(rcore.sum())},
 'expression_frames':len(expr),'assets':assets
}
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2,sort_keys=True),encoding='utf-8')
print('COMPONENT_SIZES_TOP', [len(x) for x in comps[:6]])
print('MASK_BBOX',bbox,'PATCH_NZ_FRAC',round(float(nz.mean()),6),'A128_FRAC',round(float(mid.mean()),6),'A240_FRAC',round(float(core.mean()),6))
print('MAPPED',x0,y0,pw,ph,'FULL_CANVAS_NZ_FRAC',round(float(rnz.sum())/(W*H),6),'A128_FRAC',round(float(rmid.sum())/(W*H),6),'A240_FRAC',round(float(rcore.sum())/(W*H),6))
print('EDGE_RGB_MAD_MIN_MED_MAX',round(min(edge_delta),3),round(float(np.median(edge_delta)),3),round(max(edge_delta),3))
print('CORE_RGB_MAD_MIN_MED_MAX',round(min(core_delta),3),round(float(np.median(core_delta)),3),round(max(core_delta),3))
print('MASK_SHA256',hashlib.sha256((out/'eye_identity_mask.png').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('OPEN_SHA256',hashlib.sha256((out/'eye_identity_open.png').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('MANIFEST_SHA256',hashlib.sha256((out/'manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('EXPRESSION_OUTSIDE_MASK_MUTATION=0_BY_CONSTRUCTION')
print('LIVE_FILES_MUTATED=0')
PY
find "$OUT" -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%P %s\n' | sort
test "$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_HTML"
echo SCOPE=SHADOW_EYE_ONLY_ASSET_CANDIDATE_NO_LIVE_MUTATION
